BEGIN;
CREATE TABLE student_learning_intent (
 intent_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
 student_id uuid NOT NULL,
 learning_path_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_learning_path(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 expected_path_revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK(expected_path_revision>=1),
 kind varchar(64) NOT NULL,
 requested_change_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(requested_change_json)='object'),
 projection_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(projection_json)='object'),
 payload_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK(payload_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 receipt_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(receipt_json)='object'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 consumed_at timestamptz NULL,
 consumed_by_consequence_id uuid NULL,
 CHECK((consumed_at IS NULL)=(consumed_by_consequence_id IS NULL)),
 CHECK(consumed_at IS NULL OR consumed_at>=created_at),
 CHECK(projection_json->>'intent_id'=intent_id::text AND projection_json->>'student_id'=student_id::text AND projection_json->>'learning_path_id'=learning_path_id::text)
);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX student_learning_intent_pending_revision ON student_learning_intent(student_id,learning_path_id,expected_path_revision) WHERE consumed_at IS NULL;
CREATE TABLE student_hybrid_application (
 consequence_id uuid PRIMARY KEY,
 student_id uuid NOT NULL,
 learning_path_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES student_learning_path(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 expected_path_revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK(expected_path_revision>=1),
 snapshot_ref varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK(snapshot_ref ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 policy_version varchar(64) NOT NULL,
 payload_hash varchar(71) NOT NULL CHECK(payload_hash ~ '^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
 consequence_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(consequence_json)='object'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 UNIQUE(student_id,learning_path_id,snapshot_ref,policy_version),
 CHECK(consequence_json->>'consequence_id'=consequence_id::text)
);
CREATE TABLE student_hybrid_application_receipt (
 consequence_id uuid PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES student_hybrid_application(consequence_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
 receipt_json jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(receipt_json)='object'),
 status varchar(32) NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('APPLIED','NO_CHANGE')),
 previous_revision bigint NOT NULL CHECK(previous_revision>=1),
 resulting_revision bigint NOT NULL,
 committed_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
 CHECK((status='APPLIED' AND resulting_revision=previous_revision+1) OR (status='NO_CHANGE' AND resulting_revision=previous_revision)),
 CHECK(receipt_json->>'consequence_id'=consequence_id::text)
);
ALTER TABLE student_learning_intent ADD CONSTRAINT student_learning_intent_consumption_receipt FOREIGN KEY(consumed_by_consequence_id) REFERENCES student_hybrid_application_receipt(consequence_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT;
CREATE FUNCTION protect_student_hybrid_immutable() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student hybrid provenance and receipts are immutable'; END; $$;
CREATE FUNCTION protect_student_learning_intent() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN
 IF ROW(NEW.intent_id,NEW.student_id,NEW.learning_path_id,NEW.expected_path_revision,NEW.kind,NEW.requested_change_json,NEW.projection_json,NEW.payload_hash,NEW.receipt_json,NEW.created_at) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.intent_id,OLD.student_id,OLD.learning_path_id,OLD.expected_path_revision,OLD.kind,OLD.requested_change_json,OLD.projection_json,OLD.payload_hash,OLD.receipt_json,OLD.created_at) OR OLD.consumed_at IS NOT NULL OR NEW.consumed_at IS NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Student learner intent provenance is immutable and consumption is one way';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END; $$;
CREATE TRIGGER student_learning_intent_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE ON student_learning_intent FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_student_learning_intent();
CREATE TRIGGER student_learning_intent_delete_guard BEFORE DELETE ON student_learning_intent FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_student_hybrid_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_learning_intent_truncate_guard BEFORE TRUNCATE ON student_learning_intent FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_student_hybrid_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_hybrid_application_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_hybrid_application FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_student_hybrid_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_hybrid_application_truncate_guard BEFORE TRUNCATE ON student_hybrid_application FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_student_hybrid_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_hybrid_application_receipt_update_guard BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE ON student_hybrid_application_receipt FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_student_hybrid_immutable();
CREATE TRIGGER student_hybrid_application_receipt_truncate_guard BEFORE TRUNCATE ON student_hybrid_application_receipt FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_student_hybrid_immutable();
COMMENT ON TABLE student_hybrid_application IS 'Immutable consequence admission; absence of terminal receipt means WAITING_SAFE_BOUNDARY. Waiting never consumes learner intent.';
COMMIT;
